text: Paste the chat. Hinglish, Hindi, English, all of it.
In seconds, a real score. Connection, empathy, and how heated it got.
Then it plays the moment back, in your own words, acted out. You finally see it from the outside.
It shows the exact line that turned it, and the kinder one you could say instead.
Every time you come back, it tracks your score, so you can watch yourselves get better.
Your recording is never saved. Your chat is read once to build your reflection. Only your walkthrough stays, and only you can open it.
Smart analysis, and a partner that actually pays attention. Shall we look at yours?
